Obligation: Anti-Fraud and Bribery Risk Management Process
Required_Proof: Annual anti-fraud and anti-bribery risk assessment, risk register, scoring methodology, and approved treatment plan.
Current signed policy, version history, approval record, and policy ownership assignment.
Distribution records and acknowledgments for employees and third parties, plus partner/agent policy adherence language.

Obligation: Anti-Fraud Training for All Personnel and Partners
Required_Proof: Training curriculum, completion report by audience, overdue roster, and refresher schedule.
Guidance process procedure, intake channel evidence, guidance request log, and response SLA tracking.
Hotline/whistleblower policy, non-retaliation policy, reporting channel setup evidence, and anonymized reporting metrics.

Obligation: Investigation and Documentation of Misconduct Allegations
Required_Proof: Investigation SOP, redacted case files, escalation path, and closure approvals.
Compensation policy linking conduct/compliance to incentives, review criteria, and sample decision documentation.
Disciplinary policy, sanction matrix, handbook references, and redacted violation-related disciplinary records.

Obligation: Third-Party Due Diligence and Compliance Requirements
Required_Proof: Due diligence SOP, onboarding checklist, risk tiering criteria, completed due diligence artifacts, and approvals.
Standard anti-fraud contract clauses/addenda, executed agreements including clauses, and exception approvals.
M&A anti-fraud due diligence policy, transaction diligence checklist, and completed diligence evidence package.

Obligation: Compliance Program Integration for Acquired Entities
Required_Proof: Post-acquisition integration playbook, day-1/day-90 compliance onboarding tasks, and completion tracker.

Obligation: Root Cause Analysis and Remediation of Misconduct
Required_Proof: Root cause analysis reports, remediation actions with owners and dates, and closure validation evidence.
